name: surface-view-path-failed-place-regions
description: A view declares its composition, and a state query of its region that waits for a failed place reads the interactionState of the region from the host after the place.
reason: The view calls reach the page as the notice view-call of a view that the host runs in a window, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
